scope: DMN navigation components, not full navigation apps

reference_families.name: OSRM
reference_families.notes: MLD and CH are configurations of one family, not additional families

reference_families.name: Google Maps
reference_families.notes: Black-box/provider reference only; Routes API is a billed product requiring billing/key and terms review. No automated collection or matched-map assumption. No paid calls authorized.

reference_families.name: Waze
reference_families.notes: Observational reference only where permitted. Public Waze service forbids automated content access; Transport SDK is partner-restricted and retiring 2026-11-01. No automation, extraction, reverse engineering or score without rights.

1.note: 12 proposed including Google Maps and Waze

1.answer: Ten minimum, more permitted; twelve references currently proposed, not yet all tested.

2.answer: Use only free, legally permitted access first; ask before any paid test.

3.answer: A plus C: retain as Not Tested, and permit separate lawful observational findings without comparable scores.

4.answer: Select complex real UK junctions wherever located, not Manchester-first; keep ordinary controls.

6.answer: Accept priority of legal and safe directions, reliability, then ETA; individual route preference ordering was not specified.

7.answer: Each category out of ten, sorted highest to lowest among comparable systems only.

8.answer: Use reproducible GPS replays and emulator/GitHub runs now; physical device later.

9.answer: A: freeze renderer as initial control; if navigation evidence requires better map/rendering software, revisit as a dependency.

10.answer: Full offline navigation required; existing offline data in another repository is user-reported, not independently validated here.

11.answer: Test everything relevant, including multi-source fusion.

12.answer: Lane and roundabout guidance must pass when objectively verifiable; missing reliable lane data is UNKNOWN, not FAIL or PASS.

13.answer: Require correct approach side and usable vehicle entrance from beginning when verifiable.

14.answer: One concise summary scoreboard by default; retain full individual evidence records underneath.

15.answer: Investigate and verify legality before declaring a manoeuvre illegal and blocking it; do not assert uncertain manoeuvres are lawful.

16.answer: Allow necessary lawful U-turns including dead ends; lack of options does not legalise prohibited turns.

17.answer: Investigate and fill missing map data using justified evidence; never fabricate or auto-publish unverified edits.

18.answer: Leave test unranked/not tested, and continue the other tests without automatically dropping engine.

19.answer: No fixed numerical minimum: representative reasonable sample with difficult cases and controls.

20.answer: Manual, lawful spot checks for context are acceptable, but are observational and not head-to-head ranks.

21.answer: Mix fast focused replays with smaller number of whole end-to-end journeys.

22.answer: Aim for DMN to be BETTER than every fairly comparable competitor on each tested issue, not merely on par. No claim of beating unavailable competitors; promotion still requires regression, legality, offline, ownership and rollback evidence, with separate release approval.
